measured_reference.head: MLP h=128 on frozen Qwen2.5-1.5B last-token features, antisymmetric BT, decorrelated

note: Constants fixed from the Phase 1 host measurement of the frozen-backbone BT reference, replacing the design's provisional 0.72/0.62 estimates. Every gate sits below the reference by a positive margin so the reference clears all five, and the cue-only and stale controls fall below the acc and adv floors. The frozen-backbone probe caps quality near 0.65 overall; a full fine-tune would reach higher but the bounded-continuous optimization structure, the exact swap invariance, and the adversarial-stratum floor above chance all hold at the measured level. T_MIN 400 s sits above the ~250 s reference so the time ramp saturates to r_det=1.0 when all gates pass, which is the bound full_reward the oracle must reach at Phase 2 item 7.
